propositions: Publication must stage only the five bridge-state files in the allowlist; unrelated files and non-allowlisted bridge-state files must not be published or destroyed
Repository checkpoints from save() and save_retired() must not independently publish to HEAD or the git index; local file changes must persist without affecting git state
Unchanged passes must create no git commit; GET rotation and retired-first failure cases must preserve pre-extraction publication and recovery semantics

Ownership and partial-state semantics must be durably recorded in ADR 0099 with explicit documentation of the persistence-vs-publication split, rollback behavior, and no-journal/no-format-migration decisions
Subsystem-scoped sole ownership exemptions apply to _resolve_via_binding_store and GHA commit-back operations; these are documented exclusions to the ownership model
